promoted.rationale: Renders clean. Dark contrast-bleed + airy density is a committed art-direction signature (not a default) that mirrors the Linear/Vercel dark editorial hero — the most distinctive of the clean candidates. Left-aligned split keeps copy-first DOM order and gives the media slot room to become a layered artifact. Deduction: media card renders short/stubby against the 3-line headline (slight vertical imbalance). Distinctiveness 8 is a calibrated judgment vs the app-ui anchors, not a measurement.
caveats: no responsive media-query — 2-col persists at 390px, documented v1 gap
axe unverified (axe-core did not inject offline; axeClean=null)

promoted.rationale: Renders clean. The bento media scaffold (1 wide cell + 3 cells, layered e1 elevation) pre-shapes the media into a believable product-surface composition — the closest of the six to the layered product screenshot that drives the real anchor's distinctiveness, and it matches its product-ui source. Proof scores marginally higher (6) because the bento cells can carry proof tiles. Deduction: bento adds mild visual complexity vs a single artifact, softening one-message to 7. Distinctiveness 8 is a calibrated judgment vs anchors.
caveats: no responsive media-query — documented v1 gap

referenceBaseline.note: Renders clean and correct, anti-slop PASS, but is the DELIBERATE catalog baseline (light/standard/typographic) against which other heroes define 'what is different' (its own MODULE.md §1). Kept as reference, not promoted to gold — distinctiveness intentionally neutral.

rejected.reason: copy { max-inline-size: var(--space-96) } clamps the copy column to 96px over the full-bleed media -> headline shatters to 1-3 chars/line ('A/ne/utr/al/sta/rtin/g...'), CTA squished, illegible. Visual craft 2. Machine gate passed overall=true because the vertical char-wrap causes 0px horizontal overflow.
same max-inline-size: var(--space-96)=96px clamp on the stacked copy -> identical char-per-line headline break. Visual craft 2.

same 96px clamp, centered -> headline becomes a vertical 1-word ribbon. Visual craft 2. Compounding: the 'centered' archetype was explicitly rejected for hero in neutral-split-hero MODULE.md (weakens the media requirement).

shipGateNote: By the strict design-critic §7 gate (overall>=8, no dim<7, distinctiveness>=8) NONE ships as a finished conversion page — copy-dependent dims (proof/empathy/benefit 5-6) are capped by placeholder copy + empty media. Gold here = best-of-N STRUCTURAL candidates for exemplar promotion once media/copy fill in, not finished 100-point pages.
